title: Self-Attribution Bias: When AI Monitors Go Easy on Themselves

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the correctness, risk, and harmfulness ratings a model assigns to identical artifacts (code patches, computer use actions, essays) when the artifact is implicitly or explicitly attributed to the model itself (via conversational structure or prompts) versus when it is presented with neutral attribution or attributed to another model.
Measuring whether models selectively inflate ratings for their own chosen multiple-choice options or generated text compared to counterfactual options or baseline ratings without attribution.
